sources.entry: Gibbon - Flexible school management platform designed to make life better for teachers, students, parents and leaders. (Source Code) GPL-3.0 PHP

summary.one_liner: Gibbon Core is the main PHP codebase of Gibbon, an open source school management platform for teachers, students, parents and schools.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes this repository as the bulk of Gibbon, including its primary functionality. Additional features can be added through separately provided modules and themes. Documentation is hosted on docs.gibbonedu.org and support is offered through ask.gibbonedu.org. The README includes a Docker-based development setup that runs a local PHP, Apache and MySQL environment via a ./up.sh script, with commands to stop it and view logs. It also points to a cutting-edge (prerelease) install path from the GitHub source and notes that translations are coordinated through the POEditor tool. Contribution guidelines, a code of conduct and a developer workflow are linked from the README.
use_cases: Run a school management system for teachers, students and parents
Set up a local development environment for Gibbon
Contribute code or translations to an open source school platform
Test prerelease versions of Gibbon from source
Extend a school platform with modules and themes
how_to_run: From the project root, run: ./up.sh (creates .env if missing, checks Docker, builds and starts the dev server container)
Stop the development environment and remove volumes: ./up.sh down
For a production install, follow the Getting Started: Installing Gibbon guide in the documentation at docs.gibbonedu.org
notable: Core codebase extended through separate modules and themes
Docker development setup driven by a single up.sh script
Cutting-edge prerelease builds available from GitHub source, with a stability warning
caveats: The README warns that the cutting-edge prerelease code is unstable and may cause data loss
The Docker dev setup requires Docker Desktop to be installed and running
Full installation and modules/themes are provided separately from this core repository
